items.title: Cuckoo
items.reason: Gretchen moves to an Alpine resort where recurring vomiting guests, Alma's seizures, a hooded attacker and a shriek that produces localized temporal repetition form a sustained unexplained-phenomenon mystery. Whole-film evidence shows the anomalies are progressively connected rather than remaining atmosphere: Henry investigates a linked death, Gretchen observes the creature's reproductive attack, König eventually reveals that the hooded woman belongs to a near-human brood-parasitic species, that the resort supports a preservation/breeding program, that Alma is one of its offspring, and that the shriek is part of the species' disorienting mechanism. The mystery therefore pays off with a concrete hidden program and biological/impossible rules, although the film remains horror-forward and some mechanics are deliberately left strange rather than exhaustively explained. DNA keeps horror high and clue-puzzling only moderate while rewarding the central anomaly, unknown rules, hidden truth, suspense and reality/time disturbance.
